title: Boston Gas Company files for approval of the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Beverly Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC99-40)
